questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to the term “perfidious”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Deceitful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"perfidious"** refers to someone or something that is deceitful or untrustworthy. It implies betrayal or dishonesty. (धोखेबाज़)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Her perfidious actions shattered the trust we had in her.
 
 
 
• **"Deceitful"** means someone who is dishonest, capable of misleading others, or being duplicitous. (धोखेबाज़)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The deceitful salesman tricked the customers into buying faulty products.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word closest in meaning to **"perfidious"** is **"deceitful"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deceitful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Upright** (ईमानदार): Refers to someone who is honest, ethical, and morally correct.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The upright judge was admired for his fairness and integrity.
 
 
 
• **Trustworthy** (विश्वसनीय): Refers to someone who can be relied upon or trusted.
 
 
 
• **Example:** She is a trustworthy friend who always keeps her promises.
 
 
 
• **Devoted** (समर्पित): Refers to someone who is loyal or dedicated, often with love and care.
 
 
 
• **Example:** He is devoted to his family and works hard to provide for them.

questions.question:

The phenomenon, though unusual, can occur ___ extended drought periods.

• **Options 1, 2,** and **3** do not fit the context correctly, as they do not imply the specific condition or state described in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The phenomenon, though unusual, can occur **under**__ extended drought periods."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Find the segment containing an error:

(1) What makes the draft law contentious is not the fiscal shift / (2) but that it assumes parity without evidence / (3) among states whose baselines are disparate / (4) and incomparable.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The grammatical issue lies in the phrase **“but that it assumes…”** appearing in part (2).
 
• After the structure **“What makes… is not X but Y”**, the two parts must be parallel.
 
• Part (1) uses a noun phrase **“the fiscal shift”**, but part (2) uses a full clause **“that it assumes parity…”**, breaking parallelism.
 
• The correct form should be a noun phrase such as **“the assumption of parity without evidence”** to maintain parallel structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“What makes the draft law contentious is not the fiscal shift but **the assumption of parity without evidence** among states whose baselines are disparate and incomparable.”* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** “What makes the draft law contentious is not the fiscal shift” — grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3:** “among states whose baselines are disparate” — correct usage; “disparate” is appropriate.
 
• **Option 4:** “and incomparable” — grammatically correct, adding logical contrast.

questions.question:
Change to passive voice:

They have been ignoring the upkeep of the archives for years.

options.text: The upkeep had been ignored by them for years.
The upkeep is being ignored by them for years.
The upkeep was being ignored by them for years.
The upkeep has been being ignored by them for years.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They have been ignoring the upkeep of the archives for years."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the upkeep of the archives" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have been ignoring" to "has been being ignored" (present perfect continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "for years" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The upkeep of the archives has been being ignored by them for years."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The upkeep had been ignored by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The upkeep is being ignored by them for years." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The upkeep was being ignored by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).

questions.question:
Convert to active voice:

It was being suggested by several sources that the operation had been compromised from within.

options.text: Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within.
Several sources have suggested that the operation was compromised from within.
Several sources suggest that the operation is compromised from within.
Several sources are suggesting that the operation would be compromised from within.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice: "It was being suggested by several sources..."
 
• To convert it to active voice, the doer of the action ("several sources") must become the subject.
 
• The passive verb form "was being suggested" changes to the active progressive form "were suggesting."
 
• The remaining part of the sentence ("that the operation had been compromised from within") stays unchanged.
 
• Thus, the active voice sentence becomes: "Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2:** Changes the tense to "have suggested," which does not match the original continuous passive meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** Uses simple present "suggest," incorrect because the original sentence indicates an ongoing past action.
 
• **Option 4:** Uses "would be compromised," which alters the meaning completely and is grammatically incorrect in context.

questions.question:
Choose the correct indirect form:

He asked me, “Have you done your homework?”

options.text: He asked me if I had done my homework.
He asked me have I done my homework.
He asked me whether I have done my homework.
He asked me whether had I done my homework.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked me if I had done my homework.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Have you done your homework?" becomes "if I had done my homework"**
 
 
• Auxiliary verb "have" is changed to "had" to match past perfect tense.
 
• Pronoun "you" is replaced with "I" to align with the perspective of indirect speech.
 
• The question format is changed to a statement format by removing the question mark.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "asked" is retained in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is structured as a statement rather than a question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He asked me if I had done my homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "He asked me have I done my homework."

 
 
• Incorrect structure: "have I done" is not suitable for indirect speech.
 
• Does not follow tense conversion rules.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He asked me whether I have done my homework."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have done" should be changed to "had done" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked me whether had I done my homework."
 
 
• Incorrect word order: "had I done" should be "I had done".

questions.question:
Arrange the sentences logically:

1. A media strategy was framed after outreach findings.

2. Demographic metrics were noted from dashboards.

3. User interactions were gathered from all platforms.

4. Analysts grouped users by age and behaviour.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The logical sequence of the sentences is determined by the flow of actions or steps in the process described.
 
• **Sentence 3 comes first** as it explains the initial step of gathering user interactions from all platforms.
 
• **Sentence 2 follows** as it captures the demographic metrics noted from dashboards after user interactions were gathered.
 
• **Sentence 4 is next** because analysts grouped users by age and behavior based on the demographic metrics.
 
• **Sentence 1 is the last** as it describes the final step where a media strategy was framed after the outreach findings were compiled.
 
• The correct sequence is **3-2-4-1**, which aligns with **Option 1**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"User interactions were gathered from all platforms. Demographic metrics were noted from dashboards. Analysts grouped users by age and behavior. A media strategy was framed after outreach findings."
